concepts.concept: Bootloader Anti-Rollback Protection, Monotonic Version Counters & Security Version Pinning
concepts.explanation: Preventing signed-firmware downgrade replay attacks where an attacker flashes an older validly signed vulnerable image: enforcing a monotonic minimum security version counter in write-protected Flash/Option Bytes or OTP storage and rejecting candidate images with security_version < min_allowed_version before jump or swap.
